marketing_description: The Philips LED Filament Bulb is a 8.8 W bulb with a Soft White 2700 K color temperature, offering a high Color Rendering Index of 90 for natural color rendering. This dimmable bulb is equivalent to a 60 W incandescent and has an average life of 15000 hours. It features a clear Medium base with an E26 code and is Title 20 Compliant.
